Changed section of `spe/evals/harness/grader.js`:

```js
const PRIORITIES = ["P1", "P2", "P3", "P4"]
const CATEGORIES = ["billing", "bug", "how-to", "account", "outage"]

function norm(value, allowed, caseFn) {
  if (typeof value !== "string") return null
  const v = caseFn(value.trim())
  return allowed.includes(v) ? v : null
}
const normPriority = v => norm(v, PRIORITIES, s => s.toUpperCase())
const normCategory = v => norm(v, CATEGORIES, s => s.toLowerCase())

function gradeField(got, want, normFn, field) {
  const w = normFn(want)
  if (w === null) throw new Error(`bad reference ${field}: ${want}`)
  const g = normFn(got)
  return g !== null && g === w ? 1 : 0
}

export function gradePriority(out, ref) { return gradeField(out.priority, ref.priority, normPriority, "priority") }
export function gradeCategory(out, ref) { return gradeField(out.category, ref.category, normCategory, "category") }
export function isCanonicalPriority(out) { return PRIORITIES.includes(out.priority) ? 1 : 0 }
```

- **Kind:** grader

- **Seen in:** r03 C2 trials listed in spe/evals/results/r03-regrade-diff.csv.
- **Fix:** The grader trims and uppercases priority and checks it against P1 to P4. It trims and lowercases category and checks it against the five categories.
